$schema_note: Structural map of the moria8 codebase, generated by static inspection of the source tree and product build artifacts. Re-derive from source and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for authoritative current figures.

project.name: moria8
project.description: A from-scratch 6502/65C02 assembly port of the Moria roguelike, targeting Commodore 8-bit machines (C64, C128, Plus/4), the Apple IIe, the Commander X16, Atari 8-bit (800XL/65XE/130XE), and the Acorn BBC Master 128, plus five ROM cartridges (C64, Plus/4, C128, CX16, Atari 8-bit), sharing one platform-agnostic game core across all seven ports.

repository_layout.role: Platform-agnostic gameplay, UI, data, and shared logic. No hardware registers allowed here.
Contract-only Commodore HAL: lifecycle, memory, IRQ, layout, screen, input, sound, storage, overlay, entropy interfaces.
Shared Commodore implementation code: MMU macros, overlay loader, catalog boot/fetch, item catalog records, disk swap, REU, save-slot policy, title screen.
C64 entry point, platform code, banked CRT cartridge glue, HAL implementation, tests, harness scripts.
C128 entry point, boot, VDC/MMU, dual-bank runtime, Magic Desk 128 cartridge glue, tests, harness scripts.
Plus/4 entry point, TED platform code, c264 magic cartridge glue, HAL implementation, tests.
Apple IIe port: ProDOS MLI storage, aux-memory/Language-Card bank access, HAL implementation, boot stub, MAME harness, memory-contract checker.
Commander X16 port: VERA 80-col display, 8 KB banked RAM ($A000-$BFFF), KERNAL storage, 128 KB cartridge boot/loader, x16emu TestBench harness, memory-contract checker.
Atari 8-bit (800XL/65XE/130XE) port: ANTIC Mode 2 / DLI display, POKEY input/audio, PORTB + 130XE cache, SIOV storage, AtariMax 128 KB cartridge, MAME harness, memory-contract checker.
Acorn BBC Master 128 port: Mode 0 LYNNE shadow-RAM blitter, ANDY + Sideways RAM (Banks 4-7) banking, MOS/DFS storage, MAME harness, memory-contract checker.
Cross-architecture modules shared by all seven ports: Save Format V2 ($22), legal stream/entry, generated 279-species monster catalog, and 361-item 'ITM2' catalog tables.
Source data consumed by build-time generators (LICENSE, SOURCE-OFFER, item/monster/title specs).

Python/shell build tooling: HAL boundary/export checkers, overlay/ZP/lint checks, disk/cartridge builders (diskart, make_pak, make_atr, make_ssd, make_easyflash, make_plus4_magic, make_c128_md128, make_cx16_cart, make_atari8_car), catalog/Huffman/string-bank encoders, memory budget reporter, and gifcapture (9 scripts). Third-party tools (kickass, applecommander, prodos) auto-download here at build time.
Architecture, domain contract, player manual, release checklist, and compendium documentation (see docs_index).
Generated payloads, disk/cartridge images, checksums, symbols, snapshots, and test scratch output. Not source of truth.
Root wrapper dispatching to platforms/commodore, platforms/apple2, platforms/cx16, platforms/atari8, and platforms/bbcmaster sub-makefiles.

c64_import_cascade.note: Exact deduplicated top-level #import sequence in platforms/commodore/c64/main.s; shows how platform HAL/contract headers precede core subsystems, followed by banked overlays and cold legal/sysinfo modules.

hal_contract.principle: Contract-only directory: platform-specific register writes, banking mechanics, KERNAL/OS wrappers, and drive behavior must live under the owning platform, not here.

modules.name: hal_storage.s
modules.purpose: Disk/save/cartridge I/O contract, phase-banded status codes

hal_contract.non_commodore_note: platforms/apple2/hal/, platforms/cx16/hal/, platforms/atari8/hal/, and platforms/bbcmaster/hal/ implement the same contract surface against their respective native OS, display, and banking hardware.

invariants: All map access goes through MapRead_*/MapWrite_* macros; only core/dungeon_data.s row tables compute MAP_BASE offsets.
core/rng.s reads entropy via 4 lda absolute reads of hal_entropy_timer* labels supplied by the platform.
Arithmetic uses core/math.s helpers; randomness uses core/rng.s, never ad hoc.
No hardware registers may appear in core/.

cartridge.type: VICE CRT Type 32 (8 KB ROML banks at $8000-$9FFF via $DE00 + 8 KB boot ROMH)

c128.memory_model: Dual-bank Bank 0 execution + Bank 1 data/map/catalog/overlay caches + 16 KB VDC RAM for disk ITEM.CAT ($1100-$1FFF + $2008-$3C6D) or MD128 ROM byte streaming

c128.source_of_truth: platforms/commodore/c128/memory128.s (ownership constants, overlap asserts); platforms/commodore/c128/main.s (segment defs, Bank 0 asserts)

plus4.video_audio: TED (screen, color/attribute, ROM/RAM switching $FF3E/$FF3F; sound stubbed)
plus4.storage: 1541-compatible D64 + c264 magic cart 256 KB CRT cartridge
plus4.memory_model: Disk-bound 64 KB with $D800-$DFFF hidden RAM (catalog/HuffIndex/Plus4HighBss) and $0400/$0600 caches dodging $0500/$07B0 KERNAL workspace, or $8000-$BFFF Type-1 ROM streaming

cartridge.name: moria8-plus4.crt
cartridge.type: c264 magic cart (VICE CRT Type 1, C1LO $FDD2 + $FDFE, 16 x 16 KB)

apple2.cpu: Apple IIe 128K, plain NMOS 6502 opcodes only
apple2.storage: ProDOS 8 via MLI (MORIA8.PAK single-open container + 2-drive save support)
apple2.memory_model: 128K main/aux/Aux-LC split: Main resident $0A00-$7BC1, A2.PLAY $7C00-$9FAE, 13-class overlay window $A400-$B9FF; Aux holds 198x66 map, A2.AUXDATA, A2.CATALOG, A2.HUFFDATA, hot overlay caches; Aux LC ($D000-$FFF9) holds recall[279], A2.CATEXT, ITEM.CAT

cx16.storage: CX16 KERNAL / HostFS / SD card (.zip bundle) + 128 KB ROM cartridge
cx16.memory_model: 38.6 KB unbanked low RAM ($0801-$9EFF) unified MORIA8.PRG + tier pool, plus $A000-$BFFF 8 KB banked RAM (23/64 banks allocated for map, AuxData, HuffData, MONSTER.EXT, ITEM.CAT, 13 overlays, TITLE, MONSTER.CAT, LEGALUI; 41 banks free) or zero-bounce 128 KB ROM Bank 32-39 preload

product_image.name: moria8-cx16.zip

cartridge.name: moria8-cx16.crt

atari8.display: 40-column ANTIC Mode 2 with DLI color zones and 1 KB RAM font (80x48 viewport)
atari8.storage: DOS 2.5 .atr image via OS SIOV ($E459) with < $4000 bounce + AtariMax 128 KB .car cartridge
atari8.memory_model: 64 KB 800XL/65XE baseline (PORTB=$FE RAM under OS ROM, MAP_BASE $C100-$CFFF, immovable I/O $D000-$D7FF, high resident $D800-$DFFF, 13-overlay window $E000-$EFFF, RuntimeBanked $F000-$FFF9) + 130XE 256/256-page cache or AtariMax Type-41 banked ROM streaming ($D510 disable)

product_image.name: moria8-atari8.atr

cartridge.name: moria8-atari8.car
cartridge.type: AtariMax 128 KB Flash Type 41 ($A000-$BFFF via $D500, $D510 disable)

bbcmaster.display: 80-column Mode 0 (640x192 bitmap in 20 KB LYNNE shadow RAM + char shadow, 198x66 viewport)
bbcmaster.storage: Acorn DFS 200 KB 80-track .ssd via MOS OSFILE/OSFIND/OSGBPB (MORIA8.PAK + streamed MONEXT/ITEMCAT)

cartridges.c64: moria8-c64.crt — VICE CRT Type 32 (512 KB banked ROML + Ultimax boot ROMH; 18 sparse 8 KB CHIPs = 139,264 B allocated / 132,845 B ROML used; 23 assets at $8100). Boot copies Default ($0801-$B638, 44,599 B) & 64.bank via $033C; overlays/catalogs/ITEM.CAT/legalui stream via $DE00; disk saves use drives 8-11.
cartridges.plus4: moria8-plus4.crt — c264 magic cart VICE CRT Type 1 (16 x 16 KB = 256 KB, 141,540 B used, 23 assets at $8100, C1LO $FDD2 + $FDFE). Enters $100E; streams 13 overlays, MONSTER.CAT/EXT, ITEM.CAT, legalui from $8000-$BFFF ROM; drops Plus4HighBss disk LRU cache; saves use drives 8-11.
cartridges.c128: moria8-c128.crt — Magic Desk 128 Ext Func ROM (VICE CRT Type 4, 16 x 16 KB = 256 KB, 141,718 B used, 30/32 assets at $8100). Boot ($DE00 + $FF00=$3A) uses cart_reader ($1FBF-$220F) + common chunk copier ($0FB0-$0FF3) to stage Bank 0/1 payloads and streams ITEM.CAT byte-by-byte from ROM instead of 16 KB VDC RAM; saves use drives 8-11.
cartridges.cx16: moria8-cx16.crt — 128 KB X16 ROM (8 x 16 KB ROM Banks 32-39 at $C000-$FFFF via ZP $01, 122,656 B used, 23 assets at $C100). Zero-bounce boot copy ($0400 stub) populates low RAM + HiRAM Banks 3-23 directly from ROM without overlapping $A000-$BFFF; legal screens read from ROM; saves use KERNAL/SD.
cartridges.atari8: moria8-atari8.car — AtariMax 128 KB Flash Type 41 (16 x 8 KB banks at $A000-$BFFF via $D500, 127,798 B used, 21 assets at $A100). Disables ROM window via $D510 (RD5=0) between accesses so Main RAM MORIA8.RES ($0C00-$BDCB, 45,515 B) stays visible; compiles out 130XE cache; streams overlays + uncompressed 57 B/rec catalogs from ROM; saves use SIOV.
